scope: Rectangular plate and straight rectangular-section member; rigid placement; no implemented kernel or tests.

rows.property: Euclidean member length and analytic error enclosure
rows.method: Use integer Pythagorean triples and rational squared endpoints around irrational lengths; verify the section 3 bound.
rows.inputs_class: Axis-aligned, 3-4-5 and 3-4-12 triples, minimum and maximum lengths, endpoints near coordinate caps.

rows.property: Input minima, caps and quaternion admission order
rows.method: Compare exact binary rationals at below/equal/above boundaries; verify codes and no frame division before admission.
rows.inputs_class: Zero/subminimum axes, subminimum and over-cap dimensions, zero section, norm and translation boundaries.

rows.property: Normalized active rigid rotation matches rational reference
rows.method: Derive a rational matrix from an integer quaternion independently; enclose input conversion and compare transformed points.
rows.inputs_class: Identity, half-turn, cyclic exact quaternion, quarter-turn and cancellation-heavy large-origin member.

rows.property: Orientation, dot and cross signs never guessed
rows.method: Check sign enclosure contains exact dyadic determinant; exact zero and uncertain are distinct; enforce fixed fallback capacity.
rows.inputs_class: Positive/negative/zero determinant, near collinear corners, subnormal components, maximally separated exponents.

rows.property: Parallel branch and orthogonal member frame
rows.method: Independently project the selected public reference direction; certify unit norms, orthogonality and positive determinant.
rows.inputs_class: Positive/negative vertical, tilt toward X and toward Y on both sides of threshold, neighboring f64 ratios.

rows.property: Gradual underflow and positive mass representability
rows.method: Enclose exact positive rational mass including eta/2; unrepresentable or uncertifiable relative mass yields no current zero.
rows.inputs_class: Smallest positive density, normal-to-subnormal mass boundary, tiny quaternion/axis components and normal minimum solids.

rows.property: Finiteness and unsupported stage precede numerical work
rows.method: Inject nonfinite values and unsupported tags; assert bounded diagnostics, prescribed precedence and no published candidate.
rows.inputs_class: NaN/infinity, unsupported profile, scaled/sheared/reflected matrix and unsupported source frame.

rows.property: Antipodal quaternion canonical equivalence
rows.method: Evaluate identical admitted inputs with q and -q; compare normalized matrix, canonical key and bytes exactly.
rows.inputs_class: Nonzero w, w=0, signed zero components and rational ideal rotations.

rows.property: Plate construction matches analytic corners
rows.method: Compute independent rational corner set from inequalities, then associate semantic face roles; do not reuse builder tables.
rows.inputs_class: Origin, minimum thickness, maximum dimensions and anisotropic plates.

rows.property: Straight rectangle extrusion matches endpoint sections
rows.method: Construct exact rational section corners for rational frames; verify endpoint centroids and perpendicular end sections.
rows.inputs_class: Horizontal, vertical, downwards, sloped and diagonal axes with explicit rectangle dimensions.

rows.property: Near-column construction remains a rectangular prism
rows.method: Use the Y-tilt counterexample and independent projected fallback; compare corner intervals and section axial extent.
rows.inputs_class: d=(0,0.0005,1000), large height, signed variants, exact vertical and X-tilt controls.

rows.property: Quad diagonal preserves oriented boundary
rows.method: Cancel directed diagonal edges of paired triangles and compare the resulting boundary to each analytic role quad.
rows.inputs_class: All six roles of both primitives; deliberately reversed and duplicated triangles.

rows.property: Feature roles, uniqueness and grammar
rows.method: Independently enumerate role intersections; compare 6+12+8 identifiers, 59-byte longest form and copy disjointness.
rows.inputs_class: Dimension edits, rigid moves, axis reversal, copies and malformed/wrong-body identifiers.

rows.property: Rounded corners retain certified embedding or fail closed
rows.method: Check intervals, nonzero faces, outward role signs and nonadjacent-face separation; reject a lost certificate.
rows.inputs_class: Thin boxes near large origins, oblique rotation, near-column frame, perturbed/collapsed corner mutations.

rows.property: Repeatable build and semantic identity under edits
rows.method: Repeat under one build profile and fixed cancellation observation; compare exact bytes and role names.
rows.inputs_class: Same input repeatedly, dimension and placement edits, input negative zeros.

rows.property: Analytic volume with correct units
rows.method: Multiply exact rational dimensions and independently enclose sqrt for member length; divide by exact 10^9.
rows.inputs_class: Normal, minimum, maximum and anisotropic boxes; no density required.

rows.property: Analytic surface area with correct units
rows.method: Sum six exact rectangle areas independently; compare the section 3 normal and absolute enclosures.
rows.inputs_class: Plate/member, minimum and maximum sides, large aspect ratio, sloped member.

rows.property: Mass requires explicit current density and volume
rows.method: Derive rational mass and separately apply the F06 status precedence; absence cannot produce zero/default density.
rows.inputs_class: Absent/null, explicit normal density, stale density/shape and unsupported/open geometry.

rows.property: Local and world bounds enclose ideal corners
rows.method: Derive centre plus absolute matrix times half-extents using independent exact/rational-interval arithmetic.
rows.inputs_class: Identity, quarter-turn, oblique rational quaternion, near-limit origins and cancellation near zero.

rows.property: Closedness, Euler, outward winding and two volume methods agree
rows.method: Independently enumerate incidence, verify one shell and Euler 2, then exact anchored tetrahedra versus analytic product; also sum triangle areas.
rows.inputs_class: Generated boxes plus deleted/reversed triangle and overlapping closed-shell mutations.

rows.property: Rigid motion leaves scalar quantities invariant
rows.method: Translate and apply rational ideal rotations; compare analytic quantities and enclose rounded mesh differences.
rows.inputs_class: Origin/large-origin boxes, signed axis directions, q/-q placements.

rows.property: Dimension scaling preserves dimensionless ratios
rows.method: Scale all authored lengths by powers of two within caps; verify V/L^3 and S/L^2 with rational references.
rows.inputs_class: Uniform parameter changes only, plate reference edge or member length; no runtime scale transform.

rows.property: Density changes mass alone
rows.method: Change only explicit density; compare the rational mass ratio and unchanged volume/mesh/shape and world keys.
rows.inputs_class: Two positive densities, absent-to-present, unchanged display appearance.

rows.property: Blob byte accounting and canonical layout
rows.method: Use independent integer size arithmetic and byte reader; compare fixed digest vector without using a production serializer.
rows.inputs_class: 392-byte primitive, generic structural counts at simultaneous caps, whole-blob page delivery.

rows.property: Every resource cap is checked before work/allocation
rows.method: Derive exact integer capacities; instrument allocation and work counters for equal/above/overflowing counts and negotiated limits.
rows.inputs_class: All mesh/topology/feature/byte caps, u32 maximum counts, query output and radius caps.

rows.property: Malformed blobs yield no current result
rows.method: Mutate length, reserved fields, finite encoding, zero counts, index/face addresses and alignment; assert bounded rejection.
rows.inputs_class: Truncated/extra bytes, unknown layout, negative zero, empty mesh and invalid indices.

rows.property: Nonanalytic/open/inward/overlapping meshes never certify engineering values
rows.method: Treat structural acceptance separately; verify no analytic construction certificate and no promoted bounds or divergence volume.
rows.inputs_class: One missing actual triangle, reversed shell, two overlapping boxes and arbitrary imported blobs.

rows.property: Cancellation discards before seal only
rows.method: Inject cancellation at P0/P1/P2/P3 and after seal; inspect complete result envelope and unchanged engine revision.
rows.inputs_class: Every declared observation point, repeated runs with identical observation point.

rows.property: Rejected edits preserve current state; accepted edits mark stale correctly
rows.method: Compare full pre/post revision and derived signatures around invalid edit and valid pending rebuild.
rows.inputs_class: Subminimum thickness update, shape-key change, stale/unknown/unsupported quantity states.

rows.property: Analytic ray-to-face picking and front/back classification
rows.method: Solve exact rational plane equations, t segment and in-face inequalities independently; exact parallel and uncertain differ.
rows.inputs_class: Front/back hit, ray origin inside, endpoint t, exact face edges and near-parallel rays.

rows.property: Point/edge/vertex picking uses closed-feature minimum distance
rows.method: Minimize rational squared distance on finite segment/ray intervals; compare endpoint and interior minima, then radius.
rows.inputs_class: Exact zero-radius edge overlap, point above face, radius boundary and 1e6 cap.

rows.property: Quantized tie ordering and truncated prefix
rows.method: Derive rounded bucket quotient and ASCII/rank order independently; compare neighboring buckets and exact identity ties.
rows.inputs_class: Equal distances across copies/features, adjacent f64 t at 4e9, all kind ranks, max_hits 1/16/64 and excess candidates.

rows.property: Dependency keys respect independent input sets
rows.method: Mutate exactly one input at a time and compare affected/unchanged keys, signatures, roles and mesh delivery.
rows.inputs_class: Rename, camera, density, placement, dimensions, display/visibility, copy and canonical quaternion sign.

rows.property: Query validation, stale tokens and list ordering
rows.method: Derive expected codes/discrete ordering from closed schemas; no partial hits or mixed snapshots on any failure.
rows.inputs_class: Zero/too-short direction, nonfinite pick, malformed/missing FeatureId, forbidden indices, stale/expired tokens.

rows.property: Real engine API and CLI have identical logical outcomes
rows.method: Run future implemented builders/queries through both entry points on a pinned revision; independent reader checks buffers and statuses.
rows.inputs_class: All supported primitives, queries, failure/cancellation and snapshot delivery; no mocked geometry.

rows.property: Pilot cuts remain unsupported before a new admission/contract
rows.method: Check the current supported-operation set excludes every cut; later issue new original plane-clip cases with conservation references.
rows.inputs_class: Plane cut, tangent/coplanar/empty clip, arbitrary boolean operation; all outside this draft.
